answer_1.quote: Contextual generation systems gain prominence, specialized generators have been developed to meet the stringent faithfulness demands of business applications and high-risk fields... As contextual generation systems gain prominence, specialized generators have been developed... like in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or summarization.
answer_1.outputs: Model responses evaluated in pairwise samples for faithfulness, completeness, conciseness, and refusal accuracy.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate 11 judge models... along with 9 general purpose/reasoning models. Our findings reveal that contextual assessment remains an open challenge... We also run RAGAS, a pointwise RAG evaluator that leverages both prompted frontier models and embedding models, as well as MiniCheck, a hallucination detector.

answer_3.quote: LLM-as-judge is a generative evaluator paradigm where LLMs are trained to produce an evaluation given the original user input, evaluation protocol, and model responses as input... We evaluate 11 judge models, ranging in size from 3.8B to 70B parameters along with 9 general purpose/reasoning models.
